theorem: Local theta relations are exactly the cut-space equations of K_{q+1}.
symbolic_proof: Fix one of q+1 geodesics as vertex 0.
For every i<j, the theta triangle (0,i,j) imposes x_ij=x_0i+x_0j over F2.
Hence every solution is a cut x_ij=a_i+a_j, unique modulo adding 1 to all potentials.
Therefore the local solution dimension is q.
A cut with s versus q+1-s vertices has weight s(q+1-s), whose nonzero minimum is q.

global_double_count.reason: every apartment has exactly two opposite point pairs and two opposite line pairs
global_double_count.active_chart_bound: if A(x) is the number of nonzero opposite-pair charts, wt(x) >= q A(x)/4
global_double_count.distance_reduction: A(x)>=4q^3 for every nonzero theta-code word would imply d>=q^4
global_double_count.upper_bound: the chamber-star word has q^4 apartments, so d<=q^4
global_double_count.remaining_wall: prove A(x)>=4q^3 in general, or identify theta relations with a complete all-q Steinberg presentation

q4_chamber_star.identity: 4*wt = q*A = 1024 for the q=4 chamber-star word
